answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts: every reward a wallet earns is locked and released across many epochs, not paid instantly. A farmer spawning a bridge of fake identities to ride early incentives gets each account only a trickle per epoch; abandoning the ridge of throwaway wallets forfeits most accrued value, so flash-farming costs more than it earns. Like cedar growing rings, reputation compounds only for wallets that stay alive, making identity cheap to verify by time-locked skin in the game.
